<details><summary>Tool use: **run_terminal_cmd** • Run command: cd "C:\Users\downl\Desktop\codex-main"; $py = @'
import os
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('.').resolve()
TARGET_DIRS = [ROOT / 'codex-rs', ROOT / 'sdk' / 'typescript']
SKIP_DIR_NAMES = {'.git', 'target', 'node_modules', '.venv', '__pycache__'}

class ConflictError(Exception):
    pass

def resolve_keep_head(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    out: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    resolved = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        if line.startswith('<<<<<<< '):
            resolved += 1
            i += 1
            head: list[str] = []
            while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith('======='):
                head.append(lines[i])
                i += 1
            if i >= len(lines):
                raise ConflictError('missing =======')
            i += 1  # skip =======
            while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith('>>>>>>> '):
                i += 1
            if i >= len(lines):
                raise ConflictError('missing >>>>>>>')
            i += 1  # skip >>>>>>>
            out.extend(head)
            continue
        out.append(line)
        i += 1
    return ''.join(out), resolved

def iter_files(base: Path):
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(base):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in SKIP_DIR_NAMES]
        for name in files:
            p = Path(root) / name
            yield p

changed: list[tuple[Path, int]] = []
errors: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []

for base in TARGET_DIRS:
    if not base.exists():
        continue
    for p in iter_files(base):
        try:
            data = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            # Skip binary/unknown encodings safely.
            continue
        if '<<<<<<< ' not in data:
            continue
        try:
            new_data, count = resolve_keep_head(data)
        except ConflictError as e:
            errors.append((p, str(e)))
            continue
        if count and new_data != data:
            p.write_text(new_data, encoding='utf-8', newline='')
            changed.append((p, count))

print(f"resolved_files={len(changed)}")
print(f"errors={len(errors)}")
for p, n in changed[:50]:
    rel = p.relative_to(ROOT)
    print(f"{rel} : blocks={n}")
if len(changed) > 50:
    print(f"... and {len(changed) - 50} more")

if errors:
    print('--- errors ---')
    for p, msg in errors[:50]:
        rel = p.relative_to(ROOT)
        print(f"{rel} : {msg}")
    raise SystemExit(1)
'@; py -3 -c $py</summary>

import os
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
TARGET_DIRS = [ROOT / 'docs', ROOT / 'codex-cli', ROOT / 'scripts']
TARGET_FILES = [ROOT / 'LICENSE']
SKIP_DIR_NAMES = {'.git', '_docs', '.specstory', 'target', 'node_modules', '.venv', '__pycache__'}

class ConflictError(Exception):
    pass

def resolve_keep_head(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    out: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    resolved = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        if line.startswith('<<<<<<< '):
            resolved += 1
            i += 1
            head: list[str] = []
            while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith('======='):
                head.append(lines[i])
                i += 1
            if i >= len(lines):
                raise ConflictError('missing =======')
            i += 1  # skip =======
            while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith('>>>>>>> '):
                i += 1
            if i >= len(lines):
                raise ConflictError('missing >>>>>>>')
            i += 1  # skip >>>>>>>
            out.extend(head)
            continue
        out.append(line)
        i += 1
    return ''.join(out), resolved

def iter_files(base: Path):
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(base):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in SKIP_DIR_NAMES]
        for name in files:
            yield Path(root) / name

changed: list[tuple[Path, int]] = []
errors: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []

for p in TARGET_FILES:

    if '<<<<<<< ' not in data:

    try:

        errors.append((p, str(e)))
        continue
    if count and new_data != data:
        p.write_text(new_data, encoding='utf-8', newline='')
        changed.append((p, count))

for base in TARGET_DIRS:
